package moba

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	"io"
	"sync/atomic"
)

// Arena 是 5v5 三路业务规则。固定配置版本和种子随对局保存；数值只是教学选择。
const ArenaVersion = "three-lanes-v1"
const ArenaSeats = 10
const (
	ArenaBuff      byte = 5
	ArenaSurrender byte = 6
	ArenaCreep     byte = 11
	ArenaTower     byte = 12
	ArenaBase      byte = 13
	ArenaNeutral   byte = 14
)

type ArenaInput struct {
	Action, Target byte
	Step           int8
	Lane           byte
}

func (c ArenaInput) Bytes() []byte { return []byte{c.Action, c.Target, byte(c.Step), c.Lane} }
func DecodeArena(raw []byte) (ArenaInput, error) {
	if len(raw) != 4 {
		return ArenaInput{}, ErrRule
	}
	c := ArenaInput{raw[0], raw[1], int8(raw[2]), raw[3]}
	switch c.Action {
	case Idle, Buy, ArenaBuff, ArenaSurrender:
		if c.Target != 0 || c.Step != 0 || c.Lane != 0 {
			return c, ErrRule
		}
	case Move:
		if c.Target != 0 || c.Step < -1 || c.Step > 1 || c.Lane > 2 {
			return c, ErrRule
		}
	case Attack, Cast:
		if c.Target < 1 || c.Target > ArenaNeutral || c.Step != 0 || c.Lane != 0 {
			return c, ErrRule
		}
	default:
		return c, ErrRule
	}
	return c, nil
}

type Fighter struct {
	X, HP, Mana, Gold, XP, Kills, Items int64
	Lane                                int
	RespawnAt, Cooldown, BuffUntil      lockstep.FrameID
}
type Arena struct {
	Version   string
	Seed      uint64
	Tick      lockstep.FrameID
	Heroes    [ArenaSeats]Fighter
	Creeps    [2][3]Creep
	Towers    [2][3]int64
	Bases     [2]int64
	NeutralHP int64
	Votes     [ArenaSeats]lockstep.FrameID
	Ended     bool
	Winner    int // 0 无胜者，1/2 为队伍而非 seat。
	Reason    string
}

func NewArena(seed uint64) *Arena {
	a := &Arena{Version: ArenaVersion, Seed: seed, Bases: [2]int64{100, 100}, NeutralHP: 60}
	for i := range a.Heroes {
		a.Heroes[i] = Fighter{X: arenaHome(i / 5), HP: 100, Mana: 20, Lane: (i % 5) % 3}
	}
	for team := range 2 {
		for lane := range 3 {
			a.Towers[team][lane] = 60
		}
	}
	return a
}
func arenaHome(team int) int64 {
	if team == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return 20
}
func arenaTower(team int) int64 {
	if team == 0 {
		return 4
	}
	return 16
}
func (a *Arena) Snapshot() []byte { raw, _ := json.Marshal(a); return raw }
func (a *Arena) Digest() string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(a.Snapshot())
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

// Hash 是 Arena 的状态 hash（与单路 State.Hash 同一做法：SHA-256 前 8 字节），快照携带它供客户端恢复后核对。
func (a *Arena) Hash() uint64 {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(a.Snapshot())
	return binary.BigEndian.Uint64(sum[:8])
}

// maxArenaSnapshot 是 Arena 检查点的业务上限；实际约几 KB，远小于框架缺省 4 MiB。
const maxArenaSnapshot = 64 << 10

// RestoreArena 是客户端用服务器参考模拟的检查点替换本地状态：严格解码（未知字段、尾随数据拒绝），
// 版本与种子必须与本局相同。字节摘要由框架核对，状态 hash 由调用方与快照携带的值比较。
func RestoreArena(raw []byte, seed uint64) (*Arena, error) {
	if len(raw) == 0 || len(raw) > maxArenaSnapshot {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	a := new(Arena)
	if err := decoder.Decode(a); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(new(any)); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	if a.Version != ArenaVersion || a.Seed != seed || a.Tick > MaxFrames || a.Winner < 0 || a.Winner > 2 || !a.Ended && a.Winner != 0 {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	return a, nil
}

// ArenaCheckpoints 是服务器参考模拟的检查点缓存，实现 lockstep.SnapshotProvider：
// 房间 owner 切帧并推进参考模拟后按间隔 Publish 一份不可变检查点；Provider 在 Match 的取快照 goroutine 上
// 只读最新一份，不碰 owner 独占的参考状态。间隔必须小于历史窗口，否则最新检查点可能早于 MinFrame。
type ArenaCheckpoints struct {
	latest atomic.Pointer[lockstep.Snapshot]
	served atomic.Int64
}

func (c *ArenaCheckpoints) Publish(reference *Arena) {
	c.latest.Store(&lockstep.Snapshot{Frame: reference.Tick, Data: reference.Snapshot(), StateHash: reference.Hash(), HasStateHash: true})
}
func (c *ArenaCheckpoints) Snapshot(_ context.Context, req lockstep.SnapshotRequest) (lockstep.Snapshot, error) {
	s := c.latest.Load()
	if s == nil || s.Frame < req.MinFrame || s.Frame > req.MaxFrame {
		return lockstep.Snapshot{}, lockstep.ErrSnapshotUnavailable
	}
	c.served.Add(1)
	return *s, nil
}

// Served 是交出检查点的次数（多个会话同时等快照时共用一次）。
func (c *ArenaCheckpoints) Served() int64 { return c.served.Load() }

// Visible 是客户端展示规则；全输入帧同步仍暴露输入，不构成对修改客户端的信息保密。
func (a *Arena) Visible(team, target int) bool {
	h := a.Heroes[target]
	if target/5 == team {
		return true
	}
	if h.HP == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for i, v := range a.Heroes {
		if i/5 == team && v.HP > 0 && v.Lane == h.Lane && distance(v.X, h.X) <= 4 {
			return true
		}
	}
	c := a.Creeps[team][h.Lane]
	return c.HP > 0 && distance(c.X, h.X) <= 3 || a.Towers[team][h.Lane] > 0 && distance(arenaTower(team), h.X) <= 4
}

// Apply 先验整帧，禁止半帧修改；固定 seat / lane 次序，所有随机数只来自保存的整数种子。
func (a *Arena) Apply(f lockstep.Frame) error {
	if a.Version != ArenaVersion || a.Seed == 0 || a.Ended || f.ID != a.Tick+1 || f.ID > MaxFrames {
		return ErrRule
	}
	commands := make([]ArenaInput, len(f.Inputs))
	last := lockstep.PlayerID(0)
	for i, in := range f.Inputs {
		if in.Player <= last || in.Player > ArenaSeats {
			return ErrRule
		}
		last = in.Player
		c, err := DecodeArena(in.Payload)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		commands[i] = c
	}
	a.Tick = f.ID
	for i := range a.Heroes {
		h := &a.Heroes[i]
		if h.HP == 0 && a.Tick >= h.RespawnAt {
			h.HP = 100
			h.Mana = 20
			h.X = arenaHome(i / 5)
			h.RespawnAt = 0
		}
	}
	for i, in := range f.Inputs {
		if a.Ended {
			break
		}
		a.act(int(in.Player)-1, commands[i])
	}
	if !a.Ended {
		a.npcs()
	}
	if a.Tick == MaxFrames && !a.Ended {
		a.Ended = true
		a.Reason = "time_limit"
	}
	return nil
}
func (a *Arena) hurt(i int, damage int64) bool {
	h := &a.Heroes[i]
	if h.HP == 0 {
		return false
	}
	h.HP = max(int64(0), h.HP-damage)
	if h.HP == 0 {
		h.RespawnAt = a.Tick + 5
		return true
	}
	return false
}
func (a *Arena) earn(i int, gold, xp int64) { a.Heroes[i].Gold += gold; a.Heroes[i].XP += xp }
func (a *Arena) act(i int, c ArenaInput) {
	h := &a.Heroes[i]
	team := i / 5
	enemy := 1 - team
	// 投降需同队四名不同成员在 30 帧内表态；死亡者也可以投票。
	if c.Action == ArenaSurrender {
		a.Votes[i] = a.Tick
		votes := 0
		for j, v := range a.Votes {
			if j/5 == team && v != 0 && a.Tick-v <= 30 {
				votes++
			}
		}
		if votes >= 4 {
			a.Ended = true
			a.Winner = enemy + 1
			a.Reason = "surrender"
		}
		return
	}
	if h.HP == 0 {
		return
	}
	switch c.Action {
	case Idle:
		return
	case Move:
		// 只在己方基地或河道换路，不能隔路瞬移攻击。
		if int(c.Lane) != h.Lane && h.X != arenaHome(team) && h.X != 10 {
			return
		}
		h.Lane = int(c.Lane)
		h.X = max(int64(0), min(int64(20), h.X+int64(c.Step)))
		return
	case Buy:
		if h.Gold >= 5 && h.Items < 3 {
			h.Gold -= 5
			h.Items++
			h.HP = min(int64(100), h.HP+20)
		}
		return
	case ArenaBuff:
		if h.Mana >= 5 && a.Tick >= h.Cooldown {
			h.Mana -= 5
			h.Cooldown = a.Tick + 6
			h.BuffUntil = a.Tick + 4
		}
		return
	}
	reach, damage := int64(1), int64(10)+h.Items*2+h.XP/20
	if c.Action == Cast {
		if h.Mana < 5 || a.Tick < h.Cooldown {
			return
		}
		reach = 3
		damage += 15
	}
	targetX := int64(0)
	target := int(c.Target) - 1
	switch {
	case c.Target <= ArenaSeats:
		v := a.Heroes[target]
		if target/5 == team || v.HP == 0 || v.Lane != h.Lane || !a.Visible(team, target) {
			return
		}
		targetX = v.X
	case c.Target == ArenaCreep:
		if a.Creeps[enemy][h.Lane].HP == 0 {
			return
		}
		targetX = a.Creeps[enemy][h.Lane].X
	case c.Target == ArenaTower:
		if a.Towers[enemy][h.Lane] == 0 {
			return
		}
		targetX = arenaTower(enemy)
	case c.Target == ArenaBase:
		if a.Towers[enemy][h.Lane] > 0 || a.Bases[enemy] == 0 {
			return
		}
		targetX = arenaHome(enemy)
	case c.Target == ArenaNeutral:
		if h.Lane != 1 || a.NeutralHP == 0 {
			return
		}
		targetX = 10
	}
	if distance(h.X, targetX) > reach {
		return
	}
	if c.Action == Cast {
		h.Mana -= 5
		h.Cooldown = a.Tick + 3
	}
	if h.BuffUntil > a.Tick {
		damage += 5
	}
	a.Seed ^= a.Seed << 13
	a.Seed ^= a.Seed >> 7
	a.Seed ^= a.Seed << 17
	if a.Seed%5 == 0 {
		damage += 2
	} // 整数伪随机，seed 随帧持久化并可回放。
	switch {
	case c.Target <= ArenaSeats:
		if a.hurt(target, damage) {
			h.Kills++
			a.earn(i, 10, 10)
		}
	case c.Target == ArenaCreep:
		c := &a.Creeps[enemy][h.Lane]
		c.HP = max(int64(0), c.HP-damage)
		if c.HP == 0 {
			a.earn(i, 5, 5)
		}
	case c.Target == ArenaTower:
		p := &a.Towers[enemy][h.Lane]
		*p = max(int64(0), *p-damage)
		if *p == 0 {
			a.earn(i, 20, 10)
		}
	case c.Target == ArenaBase:
		a.Bases[enemy] = max(int64(0), a.Bases[enemy]-damage)
		if a.Bases[enemy] == 0 {
			a.Ended = true
			a.Winner = team + 1
			a.Reason = "base"
		}
	case c.Target == ArenaNeutral:
		a.NeutralHP = max(int64(0), a.NeutralHP-damage)
		if a.NeutralHP == 0 {
			for j := range a.Heroes {
				if j/5 == team {
					a.earn(j, 15, 5)
					a.Heroes[j].BuffUntil = a.Tick + 10
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
func (a *Arena) npcs() {
	for team := range 2 {
		enemy := 1 - team
		for lane := range 3 {
			c := &a.Creeps[team][lane]
			if c.HP == 0 {
				if a.Tick%6 == 0 {
					c.HP = 20
					c.X = arenaHome(team)
				}
			} else {
				attacked := false
				for j, h := range a.Heroes {
					if j/5 == enemy && h.HP > 0 && h.Lane == lane && distance(c.X, h.X) <= 1 {
						a.hurt(j, 4)
						attacked = true
						break
					}
				}
				if !attacked {
					if a.Towers[enemy][lane] > 0 && distance(c.X, arenaTower(enemy)) <= 1 {
						a.Towers[enemy][lane] = max(int64(0), a.Towers[enemy][lane]-5)
					} else {
						direction := int64(1)
						if team == 1 {
							direction = -1
						}
						c.X = max(int64(0), min(int64(20), c.X+direction))
					}
				}
			}
			if a.Towers[team][lane] == 0 {
				continue
			}
			other := &a.Creeps[enemy][lane]
			if other.HP > 0 && distance(other.X, arenaTower(team)) <= 2 {
				other.HP = max(int64(0), other.HP-5)
				continue
			}
			for j, h := range a.Heroes {
				if j/5 == enemy && h.HP > 0 && h.Lane == lane && distance(h.X, arenaTower(team)) <= 2 {
					a.hurt(j, 5)
					break
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
